title: Approved testimonials
description: Filled by a maintainer from an approved 'Share your experience' issue. Nothing is rendered straight from an issue: an issue is a text box on the internet, and the homepage carries named people vouching for the project.

quote.description: The line shown on the card.

name.description: Exactly as they asked to be credited.

role.description: Role and company, e.g. 'Engineering lead, Acme Logistics'.

photo.description: Committed under public/testimonials/, not hotlinked from the issue: GitHub user-content URLs are not a CDN and a broken face reads worse than no testimonial.

link.description: Their site, GitHub or LinkedIn, so a reader can check they exist.

source.description: The issue it came from, so the permission trail is one click away.
